lines.text: Deep down, the sea presses in from every side. How does a submarine stay there for weeks?
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: First, a pressure hull. Thick steel, braced by ring frames, keeps the crew's world at surface pressure.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: But a sealed hull has a problem. Every breath uses oxygen and adds carbon dioxide to the air.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: So the boat carries its own life support: an oxygen supply, and scrubbers that pull carbon dioxide out of the air.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: Underwater, the motor runs on batteries. And every hour submerged drains them.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: Air independent propulsion stretches that time. Fuel cells turn stored hydrogen and oxygen into electricity and water, with no air from the surface.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: The electric motor turns the propeller quietly. Isolation mounts keep machinery noise from reaching the water.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: To find its way, it listens. Passive sonar picks up distant sounds, while navigation systems track every move.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: Put it all together, and you get Türkiye's Reis class, derived from the Type 214.
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype

lines.text: Its endurance depends on energy, supplies and its crew. So, can it stay submerged for weeks?
lines.style: calm, confident documentary narrator; clear and measured, low warmth, no hype
